  PROBLEM: The V1 state-comment regex expects a one-line opener, so it does not detect real multi-line V1 state comments.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15797-15803 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]

  WHY: A project in another non-failed status, such as `security-pass` or `security-pass-fixing`, can be closed while still active.
- tests/test_unblock_scan.py:278 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The parametrized test expects a project with `status="security-pass"` to be closable.
  WHY: This validates the incorrect behavior enabled by the status guard; severity differs between reviewers, with BLOCKER highest and MAJOR also reported.
- tests/test_unblock_scan.py:313-332 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The V1 state-comment fixtures use a one-line opener that does not match the real multi-line V1 comment format.
  WHY: The fixture and regex share the same incorrect format, so tests can pass without detecting that production V1 state writes go unrecognized; severity differs between reviewers, with BLOCKER highest and MAJOR also reported.
- tests/test_unblock_scan.py:290-295 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `test_project_close_refuses_a_removed_stop_label` uses `status="security-pass"` rather than `status="failed"`.
  WHY: Once the status guard requires `failed`, the test will refuse on status before reaching the missing-label check it is meant to exercise.
- tests/test_unblock_scan.py:298-303 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `test_project_close_refuses_a_resumed_project_even_with_stale_block_label` covers only `status="in_progress"`.
  WHY: It does not verify that other non-failed statuses, including `security-pass` and `security-pass-fixing`, are blocked.
